review.summary: Re-reviewed the full committed TASK-059G branch against main, excluding AI-review records, with focus on the round 3 fixes in the Docker cleanup job, the deploy-release failure reporting, the deployment documentation, the runtime QA script and the QA record. The fix also closes a second instance of the F-001 defect: a failed build-cache prune had been hidden behind a pipeline. Before the fix, a docker shim with a reachable API but failing listings reproduced the false status=completed; after it, the shim produced status=failed. Script syntax checks, shellcheck at warning severity and verify-production-compose.sh passed. The disposable end-to-end verify-production-runtime.sh ran on an isolated Docker-in-Docker daemon at da7caee and passed with 38 PASS groups and no failures. That run includes new checks for failing ps, images and builder calls, and for a post-migration gate failure followed by fix-forward. Later commits changed only the QA record and the wording of the recovery hint; the QA assertion pattern still matches. No production host, DNS, tenant or backup directory was touched. No new actionable findings. This review is advisory and does not replace human approval.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: The container, image-protection and image listings are captured with explicit status checks. A failure aborts with status=failed and exit 1 before that phase removes anything. The build-cache prune status is no longer masked by a pipeline. Runtime QA asserts status=failed for failing ps, images and builder calls, and DEPLOYMENT.md documents the behavior.

deploy-release records SERVICES_REPLACED in every failed deployment record. Once new-release application containers may have started, the failure message says they may be partly running and names both recovery options: fix forward, or a schema-compatible rollback. DEPLOYMENT.md explains that unchanged pointers do not mean the previous release is serving. Runtime QA asserts SERVICES_REPLACED=false for a failed migration. For a forced post-migration health failure, it asserts the partly-running message, SERVICES_REPLACED=true and unchanged pointers, followed by a successful fix-forward.
The developer decided that no freshness limit is needed for restore-rehearsal evidence. The gate still requires the selected or latest evidence to report STATUS=success. No code change was made.
